question: How many annual leave days do I get per year?
gold_answer: 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

question: I joined on 1 September. How many vacation days do I get this year?
gold_answer: 8 working days (2 days per full month, September to December).

question: How many unused vacation days can I carry over to next year, and until when do I have to use them?
gold_answer: Up to 5 days; they must be used by 31 March of the next year, otherwise they expire.

question: How far in advance do I need to request a two-week vacation?
gold_answer: At least 14 calendar days before the start date (leave longer than 3 working days).

question: How much notice do I need to give for a single day of annual leave?
gold_answer: At least 2 working days before the start date.

question: What happens if two people from my team are already on vacation on the days I want?
gold_answer: The request goes to HR review; HR confirms with the team lead and decides within 3 working days.

question: How many days off do I get for my own wedding?
gold_answer: 3 working days of paid special leave, not deducted from annual leave.

question: How many days off do I get if a close family member dies?
gold_answer: 3 working days of paid bereavement (special) leave.

question: How many days of unpaid leave can I take in a year?
gold_answer: Up to 20 working days per year; every unpaid leave request needs manager approval via HR review.

question: Is 24 December 2027 a day off?
gold_answer: Yes, 24 December 2027 is a company day off (winter company day).

question: What happens if I have to work on a company holiday?
gold_answer: It needs prior manager approval and is compensated with another day off within 30 days.

question: Can I request annual leave through the HR assistant?
gold_answer: No: as a contractor you are not covered by the leave policy; agree on time off with your manager under your service agreement.

question: Do I get fewer vacation days because I work part-time?
gold_answer: No, part-time employees get the same 24 days; leave pay is proportional to contracted hours.

question: Can I cancel a vacation that I already booked?
gold_answer: Yes, a pending or approved request can be cancelled before the leave starts; the days return to the balance.

question: I've been sick for 2 days. Do I need a medical certificate?
gold_answer: No, up to 3 consecutive working days do not need a medical certificate; just register the sick days.

question: I'm going to be ill for 5 days. Do I need a sick note?
gold_answer: Yes, more than 3 consecutive working days require a medical certificate; HR reviews and approves the request.

question: How many sick days per year are paid at 100% of salary?
gold_answer: Up to 10 sick days per calendar year at 100%; beyond that, state social insurance rules apply.

question: I got sick during my vacation and I have a medical certificate. Do I get those vacation days back?
gold_answer: Yes, the overlapping annual leave days are returned to the balance; contact HR with the certificate.

question: Do I get paid sick leave?
gold_answer: No, contractors do not receive paid sick leave; inform your manager according to your service agreement.

question: How many days per week can I work from home?
gold_answer: Up to 3 days per week, by agreement with your team lead.

question: Can I get money for a coworking space?
gold_answer: Yes, as a fully remote employee you can claim up to 100 USD per month through the expense process.

question: Can I claim the coworking allowance?
gold_answer: No, office-based employees are not eligible because they have access to an office.

question: I want to work from Portugal for 2 weeks. Is that allowed?
gold_answer: Yes, up to 30 days per year; notify HR at least 10 working days before departure and confirm the country is not sanctioned and the internet is stable.

question: What are the core hours when I must be available?
gold_answer: 11:00 to 16:00 Kyiv time.

question: When do I have to complete the information security training?
gold_answer: Within 14 calendar days of the start date; production access is granted only after it.

question: How long is the probation period?
gold_answer: 3 months.

question: What does my onboarding buddy do and for how long?
gold_answer: A buddy from a neighbouring team helps with informal questions, tools and culture for the first 3 months.

question: Does the company pay for my family's health insurance?
gold_answer: The company covers 50% of the cost for spouse and children; the other 50% is deducted from salary.

question: How much sport compensation do I get?
gold_answer: 500 UAH per month (part-time, after probation).

question: Can I use the education budget now?
gold_answer: Not yet: the education budget (600 USD per year for full-time) starts only after probation.

question: Does the sport compensation cover buying sports equipment?
gold_answer: No, sport equipment purchases are not covered.

question: Can I carry over unused education budget to next year?
gold_answer: No, the education budget is annual and does not carry over.

question: How many sessions with a psychologist does the company pay for?
gold_answer: Up to 6 sessions per year, fully paid.

question: Do I need approval to buy a 300 USD online course from my education budget?
gold_answer: Yes, spending over 100 USD requires prior approval from the team lead.

question: I took a taxi home at 23:00 after working late. Can I get reimbursed?
gold_answer: Yes, up to 400 UAH per ride for office-based employees working past 22:00.

question: What is the per diem on business trips?
gold_answer: 50 USD per day for meals, plus accommodation up to 120 USD per night.

question: How long do I have to submit a receipt for an expense?
gold_answer: Within 30 calendar days of the expense, through the Expenses form with a photo of the receipt.

question: What is the spending limit for a client dinner?
gold_answer: 40 USD per person, approved in advance by the team lead.

question: How often is my laptop replaced?
gold_answer: Every 3 years, or earlier if it is broken and cannot be repaired.

question: I lost my company laptop. What should I do?
gold_answer: Report it to IT within 24 hours so the device can be locked remotely.

question: Can I get money for a chair for my home office?
gold_answer: Yes, fully remote employees get a one-time 300 USD home office allowance after probation, claimed through expenses.

question: A client wants to give me a gift worth 80 USD. Can I accept it?
gold_answer: No, gifts are allowed up to 50 USD; a more valuable gift must be declined or reported to HR.

question: Where can I report harassment anonymously?
gold_answer: Through the anonymous ethics hotline in the HR portal (or hr@lumora.example); reports are confidential.

question: Can I work on a side project on weekends?
gold_answer: Yes, if it does not compete with Lumora Tech, uses no company resources and involves no company clients.

question: How long does it take to get an employment certificate?
gold_answer: 2 working days, in Ukrainian or English.

question: How much is the referral bonus and when is it paid?
gold_answer: 1,000 USD, paid after the new hire passes probation.

question: I changed my bank account. When do I have to report it so this month's salary goes to the new account?
gold_answer: At least 5 working days before payroll; later changes take effect from the following month.
